referenceItems.statement: Publication occurs only under approval bound to the exact preview, an allowed role, and a timestamp no more than 30 minutes old.

acceptedAlternatives: Requester may also approve only with separate role evidence
referenceItems.statement: Request authorship alone does not convey approval authority.

acceptedAlternatives: Equivalent preview-digest, authority, scoped-write, and read-back protocol
referenceItems.statement: The workflow previews first, verifies digest, role, and age, writes only the named service, and reads back exact fields.

acceptedAlternatives: Explicit create or publish request containing all banner fields
referenceItems.statement: Positive activation requires explicit create or publish intent plus service, window, message, and audience.

acceptedAlternatives: Strategy, general incident messaging, or existing-banner editing
referenceItems.statement: Status strategy, general incident communication, and editing an existing banner are outside activation.

acceptedAlternatives: Emergency wording or self-asserted authority permits preview only
referenceItems.statement: Emergency language, stale approval, digest mismatch, and unsupported authority must not produce publication.
Compatible evidence binds an allowed role to the exact preview and directly reads back the endpoint state.
Requester assertion, prose job title, or a success code without read-back cannot prove authority or correct publication.
No unauthorized or cross-service write, expanded audience or window, separate notification, or inferred authority is allowed.

acceptedAlternatives: Compensating delete after absent or mismatched read-back
referenceItems.statement: Publication failure or read-back mismatch triggers deletion by returned identifier and reports both outcomes.
